sources.title: National Policy Statements for energy infrastructure
sources.facts: 2025 EN-1, EN-3 and EN-5 came into force 6 January 2026; EN-7 came into force 18 December 2025.
sources.guard: Collection status does not establish that a project is an NSIP, falls within a technology threshold or satisfies assessment policy.

sources.title: Overarching National Policy Statement for energy (EN-1), 2025
sources.facts: EN-1 came into force 6 January 2026 and sets need, assessment and mitigation policy for significant energy infrastructure.
sources.guard: National need and policy weight are not consent, site suitability, grid connection, land rights or mitigation acceptance.

sources.title: National Policy Statement for renewable energy infrastructure (EN-3), 2025
sources.facts: EN-3 came into force 6 January 2026 for nationally significant renewable energy infrastructure.
sources.guard: Technology policy is not confirmation that a specific scheme meets thresholds, has consent or resolves environmental impacts.

sources.title: National Policy Statement for electricity networks infrastructure (EN-5), 2025
sources.facts: EN-5 came into force 6 January 2026 for nationally significant electricity-network infrastructure.
sources.guard: Network policy is not a route, connection offer, compulsory-acquisition right, capacity reservation or consent.

sources.title: National Networks National Policy Statement
sources.facts: Designated 24 May 2024; applies to applications accepted for examination after that date.
sources.guard: Designation date and national need do not prove a specific road, rail or freight scheme is accepted, consented or deliverable.

sources.title: Amended national policy statement for ports
sources.facts: Final proposed amended text was laid before Parliament on 6 July 2026 for a 21-sitting-day consideration period.
sources.guard: Laying proposed text is not designation; the 2012 NPS remains the designated framework until a later verified step.

sources.title: Planning Act 2008: procedures for reviewing and amending National Policy Statements
sources.facts: Lists review and update dates, including 6 January 2026 EN-3/EN-5 and 24 May 2024 NNNPS.
sources.guard: Review timetable is not project applicability, transitional-rule resolution or development consent.

sources.title: National Policy Statements for energy: appraisal of sustainability
sources.facts: Updated 6 January 2026; 2025 appraisal applies to EN-1, EN-3 and EN-5.
sources.guard: Strategic appraisal is not a project environmental statement, habitats assessment, site survey or mitigation approval.
